away.summary: The Dallas Stars are looking to start the 2026-27 season on a positive note after a 4-0 loss to the St. Louis Blues. Jake Oettinger is confirmed to start in goal, with Casey DeSmith possibly joining him if needed. Matt Duchene is out due to a lower-body injury, while the team is relying on veteran players to execute their new tactical approach.

home.summary: The Nashville Predators are eager to start their 2026-27 season with a strong performance. Juuse Saros is confirmed to start in goal, with Matt Murray as his backup. The team is healthy and has a mix of returning core players and new additions, including Mavrik Bourque and Ross Colton, who are set to make their debuts. The Predators are looking to build on their strong regular-season opener history.
